name: Thorek Ironbrow
canonNotes: Runelord of Karak Azul and the greatest living runesmith, obsessed with recovering lost artefacts of the ancestors.
Carries the Anvil of Doom and trusts ancient runecraft over any new invention.
voiceNotes: Cantankerous, traditional and scornful of 'newfangled' ideas and engineers.
Talks of runes, relics and the old ways; greedy for lost artefacts.
sources: Total War: WARHAMMER III, in-game unit lore (summarised, not quoted)
